snippet.title: Assetto Corsa Gran Turismo - A Major Modification (Promo)
snippet.description:
I'm creating a major mod for Assetto Corsa that implements an entire new career system similar to that seen in Gran Turismo. I'm using Unity to be able to have menus structured to look like a real game. The ambition is to be able to give Assetto a breath of fresh air and changes. With this video i wanted to advertize people of this project. Let me know what do you think in the comments!

(Background videos are a modification of some of your videos. They are not mine, and unfortunately I don't remember all the links of all the videos I used. I will write them here when I have found them all!)
